name: Kojin Kyouju: La Leçon Particulière
original_name: 個人教授 La Leçon Particulière
source:
In the game, the player plays the role of a new high school teacher who is asked by numerous girls to instruct them in private lessons to prepare them for college entrance exams.  Right.  I'm sure that's the only thing going on here...

[From [url=https://www.retromags.com/gallery/image/16953-kojin-kyouju-la-le%C3%A7on-particuli%C3%A8re-japan/]retromags[/url]]
translation:
在游戏中，玩家扮演一位新来的高中老师，被众多女孩请来指导她们上私人课程，为她们准备高考。正确的。我确信这是这里唯一发生的事情……

[来自[url=https://www.retromags.com/gallery/image/16953-kojin-kyouju-la-le%C3%A7on-particuli%C3%A8re-japan/]retromags[/url]]
